REFUSED notes/note-20261001T1800Z-3c11-home-path.md: profile line 11

The `3c09-registry-agent` and `3c10-registry-task` records passed all three checks. Their git commands for filing are below, printed but not run, so neither record has a `FILED` line. Wherever `<commit>` appears, a real run would put the hash printed by the `log` command before it. The `3c11-home-path` record failed the profile check because line 11 contains a real home path.
